hotels.title: NSW Southern Highlands Escape: Bowral One- & Two-Bedroom Apartments with Indoor Pool
hotels.description: Step into refined Southern Highlands elegance at this apartment retreat, where manicured gardens and grand architecture evoke Bowral’s genteel heritage. Featuring self-contained apartment stays for every kind of traveller - plus a shimmering heated indoor pool and fitness centre - it's the perfect base for discovering the region's best. Wander to the nearby Corbett Gardens, renowned for hosting annual Tulip Time Festival, or explore the boutiques and antique stores lining Bong Bong Street. For a leisurely afternoon, tee off at Bowral Golf Club or stroll through the Bradman Museum and International Cricket Hall of Fame.
